description: pixel art landscape, a massive old stone hall of trials at the edge of a forest village at dusk, a wide arched gate flanked by two stone statues of armed warriors, torches in iron brackets, through the open gate a sand arena with wooden fences and weapon racks, red banners with crossed swords on the walls, thin ice-blue glowing runes carved around the arch and faint luminous blue lines on the path leading to it, wide panorama for a dim background behind text, low contrast, muted dark palette of deep greens, greys and browns with warm torchlight and ice-blue accents, no text, no border, no people
